I just moved into an early 90's rental home and trying to figure out where I'm going to put our computer/bill paying station is stressing me out. If it's in our bedroom then when I work on bills/phone calls I'll have to keep my door open to hear the kids and that open door translates to permission to play in mommy and daddy's room in toddler speak. The kitchen and breakfast nook is too small. I have a walk in closet in the kids toy room, but no outlet and low shelves make finding a sturdy desk and file system to fit the space difficult. I look forward to the day contractors carve out holes in the walls to shelve this stuff as part of the standard design of the house. Our grandkids will look at us in dismay and say, "You didn't have a media center room!?" like we looked at our grandparents when we learned they didn't have bathrooms, and our parents who didn't have TV.
